similarityPairs.decision: Retain these distinct scopes despite overlapping equality and social-policy responses. Do not tune the shared economic answers to manufacture distance.

Retain the original author-specific school and the broader classical Marx–Engels reconstruction. These doctrinal differences merit separate entries; no answers changed to evade the threshold.
